claim_boundary: Regular-locus slope-witness PDP stage pilot only. A pinned planted result is a correctness control, not natural relation yield. Bounded unknown is not UNSAT. No complete target recovery or speedup can be claimed without factor logs, target descent, same-point rho, and isolated paired timing.
factor_policy: Same exact W3/W4 ordered normal-basis selector and measured projected factor base as indexed-factor pilot. Each factor y is a free witness constrained by y^2+xy=x^3+1. Each regular affine addition has a free slope witness constrained by slope*(x_left+x_right)=y_left+y_right. Nonzero factor x and unequal-x additions are enforced.
run_order: First pass exhaustive GF(2^5) false-lift and equal-x controls. Then run one pinned-factor planted raw fiber under the same CMS resource envelope, independently replay any SAT model in checked Sage, run public-only unpinned planted, and all four frozen ordinary raw fibers. Retain every failed attempt and phase cost.
